response.summary: The run completed as a valid, strict-execution delivery with a quality pass and scientific_success=true. The selected candidate was ridge_full_5_10, the only ridge configuration actually observed; it achieved a search validation error of 0.046592746444219596, below the 0.2 threshold. A sealed error of 0.05678283862595852 is reported. The mean baseline was also observed at 0.2361158964908156. All other ridge candidates were untried. This is controlled synthetic regression on a demo split, not scientific discovery, and the sealed error is not a blind-test result.

findings.claim: Delivery was valid and strict execution held, with explicit_submit termination, zero retries, and no fixture faults.
findings.evidence: verified_report: valid=true, strict_execution=true, termination=explicit_submit, retries=0, fixture_faults=false, complete=true

findings.claim: Quality pass and scientific_success were both true.
The selected candidate ridge_full_5_10 was observed and succeeded, with validation mean 0.046592746444219596 and std 0.018048377849544033.
The selected candidate's search validation error was below the 0.2 threshold.
The mean baseline was observed and succeeded with validation mean 0.2361158964908156 and std 0.08348837920905393.
All other ridge candidates (half-fidelity grids and full-fidelity 3-grid variants) were untried, so no comparative ranking among them is supported.
findings.evidence: public_evidence_index: 11 ridge entries with observed=false, status=untried, attempts=0

findings.claim: A sealed error of 0.05678283862595852 is reported, with one evaluation read.
Resource use was modest: 4 decisions, 3 tool attempts, 1 LLM request, 1689 LLM tokens, 3.897 active seconds, search_cu 6.0, finalization_cu 2.

limitations: The task is controlled synthetic regression on a demo split (provenance.source=controlled_generated_regression, split=demo); it is not scientific discovery.
The sealed error is a single reported value from one evaluation read; it is not a blind-test result and should not be treated as independent confirmation.

Only two candidates were observed (mean and ridge_full_5_10); the remaining 11 ridge configurations were untried, so no evidence supports claims about their performance or about optimality of the selected configuration.
No tuning or selection guidance based on the sealed error is offered; the sealed result is reported as-is.
No tool registry entries were available, so no tool-level verification beyond the provided evidence index is possible.
Recovery and abstention were not exercised: retries=0 and termination was explicit_submit, so no evidence exists about behavior under those conditions.
